# GitHub Actions

`.github/` holds the GitHub Actions workflows of this repository in `workflows/`: `ci.yml`, which checks every pull request and every push to `main`, the checks it calls, the deploy workflows and the weekly image scan. `scripts/` holds the scripts that the checks and `games.yml` run. It is not a [project](/docs/glossary.md#project) and has no [specification](/docs/conventions/specs.md).

- [workflows.md](/.github/docs/workflows.md): rules for every workflow file: action pinning, the permissions and secrets of reusable workflows, job time limits, and how a change to a workflow can be tried. Read it before changing any workflow.
- [checks.md](/.github/docs/checks.md): `ci.yml`, the `check-*.yml` workflows and the scripts in `scripts/` that they run, and how to add a check. Read it before changing them.
- [deploys.md](/.github/docs/deploys.md): which workflow deploys what, which changes start it, how `infra.yml`, `site.yml`, `deploy-project.yml`, `games.yml` and `temp-sites.yml` work, how a deploy waits for its containers and what `games.yml` checks on the live site after it, and what a deploy leaves on the VPS. Read it before changing a deploy workflow or a Compose file that one deploys.
- [games-changes.md](/.github/docs/games-changes.md): how `games-changes.yml` finds the packages and [deployments](/docs/glossary.md#deployment) of `games/` that a change reaches. Read it before changing `games-changes.yml` or what `ci.yml` and `games.yml` take from it.
- [image-scan.md](/.github/docs/image-scan.md): `image-scan.yml`, the only vulnerability scan of the images. Read it before changing `image-scan.yml`, adding a Compose file at a new path, or adding a scan to a deploy.
- [github-setup.md](/.github/docs/github-setup.md): the repository secrets and the GitHub Container Registry access that the workflows rely on, and the rulesets on `main`. Read it before adding a secret or a deployment that pushes a new image, or proposing a change to the rulesets or a direct push or force push to `main`.
- [/www/docs/tests.md](/www/docs/tests.md): how `check-www.yml` takes new screenshots of `www/` and how they are approved. Read it before changing what `check-www.yml` uploads.
- [screenshot-tests.md](/www/docs/decisions/screenshot-tests.md): why `www.yml` does not wait for `check-www.yml`.
- [screenshot-updates.md](/www/docs/decisions/screenshot-updates.md): why `check-www.yml` makes the new screenshots of `www/` for an agent to commit.
- [ci-checks.md](/docs/decisions/ci-checks.md): why the checks are reusable workflows without secrets, why `ci.yml` skips checks with `if:`, and why it runs on pushes to `main` too.
- [docs-check.md](/docs/decisions/docs-check.md): why `ci.yml` checks the links of the [documents](/docs/glossary.md#document) and the tests of the requirements in every change.
- [games-check-scope.md](/docs/decisions/games-check-scope.md): which packages of `games/` `ci.yml` tests, why pnpm finds them on the runner, which deployments `games.yml` deploys, why it tests the whole workspace, which images the checks build, and why they start them and wait for their health checks.
- [pnpm-in-images.md](/games/docs/decisions/pnpm-in-images.md): why `check-games.yml` and the Dockerfiles in `games/` take pnpm from `ghcr.io/pnpm/pnpm` instead of Corepack or npm. Read it before changing how they get pnpm or Node.
- [games-routing.md](/docs/decisions/games-routing.md): why nginx reaches the containers of the games itself, which is why the games deploy onto their own network `wp_games`.
- [game-names-check.md](/docs/decisions/game-names-check.md): why a check of its own keeps other containers off the names that nginx reaches for the games, and why no deploy calls it.
- [deploy-checks.md](/docs/decisions/deploy-checks.md): why every deploy of `deploy-project.yml`, temporary sites included, waits for its containers' health, why `games.yml` then checks the live site over public HTTPS, why that check opens no room and why a failed deploy rolls nothing back.
- [scans-in-deploys.md](/docs/decisions/scans-in-deploys.md): why only the weekly `image-scan.yml` scans the images, and no deploy.
- [main-branch-protection.md](/docs/decisions/main-branch-protection.md): why two rulesets on `main`, with no bypass, block force pushes and deletion and require a pull request and the `result` check of `ci.yml`, and why branches need not be up to date.
